caveats: You may find some missing polygons (admin boundaries).
dataset_source: Democratic Republic of Congo Ministry of Health, WHO
license_other: This data is provided by the WHO open data platform for the May 2018 Ebola outbreak and should be use  to assist in providing a coordinated response.
methodology_other: Administrative level 2 health  boundaries consolidated according to Ministry of Health and World Health Organization data
name: democratic-republic-of-congo-health-boundaries
notes: The zip file contains Health region (adm1) and districts boundaries (adm2) for DRC in shapefile and GeoJSON format.  These datasets can be found in the WHO Ebola open data platform: https://ebolaoutbreak2018-who.opendata.arcgis.com
